name: IN/OUT: Breathing Timer
subtitle: Breathe for what's next
shortDescription: Guided breathing, custom patterns and private before-and-after check-ins.
description:
Choose a structured breathing practice, follow native visual, audio and haptic guidance, and optionally record how you feel before and afterward. Core practice works offline without an account. All ten current breathing protocols are included in Free.

Commercial v1 includes Free/Pro controls, private practice insights, local reminders and a browser exercise implementation. Provider integrations and final subscription pricing/trial terms are still under development. This draft is not approved store copy.

State Shift is self-reported, not biometric. Breathe comfortably and stop if dizzy, faint or unwell. IN/OUT is not a medical device. High-intensity cyclic breathing requires a separate safety confirmation before each practice.
